Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: 16:9 wide music-video starting frame for one continuous alien-coast experience.
Input 1: full-body Harper reference for adult auburn curls, freckles, gray short-sleeve T-shirt, gray trousers and bare feet; recreate her standing naturally instead of floating. Input 2: original detailed Harper interior portrait for face. Input 3: established alien planet for the world palette and jagged archipelago design.
New scene: Harper experiencing a virtual planetary shore as if physically there. Show the place directly and leave its VR nature unexplained: no digital overlay, headset, spacesuit, projected avatar transparency or spacecraft. A beautiful immense non-terrestrial coast of broad long peach/rose tidal flats, shallow luminous turquoise sea, dark blue angular rock spires/archipelagos and pale peach clouds in a cyan-violet hazy sky. Strong long curving tide bands leading into the distance. Camera is an oblique elevated wide view, Harper occupies left-of-center but is large and clearly identifiable, full adult body about half the image height, barefoot on damp reflective flats. Her proportions stay human, but she is about three times the scale of nearby alien plants and creatures, her interactive projection can be oversized in this world. Place readable small alien flora in foreground/around her feet: translucent violet ribbed fan fronds, amber stalks with segmented umbrella crowns, sparse low coral-like pale-blue colonies. A few distinctive tiny six-legged pearlescent shelled tidal animals move in shallow channels; avoid earthly crabs, gulls, fish, palms or trees. There is quiet natural diversity rather than clutter. Harper faces toward the sea in a three-quarter view with her face still readable, relaxed delighted/wondering expression, arms beginning to open but NOT fully stretched yet, shoulders low, two anatomically natural arms/hands and two bare feet clearly posed. Leave ample lateral room for the arms to open wide in the animation; hands not near image boundaries. Coastal camera sees out to open ocean and spires. Initial tide is midway across the flats; broad shallow parallel tide fronts will gently advance/recede in response to her gesture later. Do not show a frozen towering tsunami or destruction. Upper-right warm sunlight rim-lights auburn curls; turquoise/peach marine color reflected in gray fabric. Painterly cinematic graphic-novel finish exactly consistent with the references, tactile expressive illustration, no photography. No moons, ship, equipment, jewelry, text, labels or HUD.
